categories.public_reference_gap: Can enrich references or select already available public supports; cannot create farm actuals.
categories.farmer_only_input: Actual farmer/field observation;public sources cannot fill it.
categories.local_validation_gap: Needs real field measurements, agronomic review or calibration.
categories.scenario_configuration: Explicit planning/model choice; labelled assumptions may support a demo, never farm history.

user_context: No actual farmer/field data supplied; user authorized publicly available sources only. Proceed with public context without requesting invented farm records.

gaps.explanation: Official catalog explicitly reports 82–93 days after planting; preserve source differences and do not auto-select cultivar.
Official FAO ecosystem definitions and separate operational water-regime/establishment vocabulary now documented.
All 91 original fields typed and unit applicability explicit; negative latitude, hectares, records and legacy weighting corrected in additive contract.
All 12 rules input requirements linked to concrete original/supplemental paths.
Old BSIP host DNS failure preserved; same resource retrieved from official BRMP host, hash and visual QA captured.
Cultivar and site-specific maturity, actual field-harvest dates, integer calendar conventions and management gaps require explicit scenario choices or local validation.
Drainage, water control, soil preparation and feasibility for a real field are unknown.
No measured fixation, residue/nutrient balance or local fertilizer-credit calibration; benefits remain null.
No identified field organism, local host range or validated rotation effect.
Species optima are historical references; no locally calibrated failure thresholds, yield response or stress-day rules.
No calibrated local Kc, effective rainfall, root-zone balance, paddy seepage/percolation or actual irrigation-accounting model.
Actual prices, costs, marketable yields and validated economic method absent; generic catalog yields cannot substitute.
Method remains reference_method_not_locally_validated; schema/reference coverage is not field approval.
